title: Regularization and renormalization of gauge fields
claim: Introduces dimensional regularization for gauge theories: separates overlapping divergences, preserves unitarity and causality, allows shifts of integration variables; Ward identities hold throughout when there are no anomalies; makes manifest where anomalies (Bell-Jackiw-Adler) can arise. Contains the non-anticommuting gamma5 (gamma5 anticommutes with the first four gamma matrices and commutes with the others) that is the 'HV' part of BMHV.
symmetry_argument: Gauge invariance of the d-dimensional regularized action (vector-like theories); anomalies localized in gamma5-dependent pieces.

proved: Unitarity/causality and Ward identities for anomaly-free cases (as stated in the abstract).

red_flags: For chiral couplings the HV gamma5 breaks gauge invariance of the regularized action by evanescent terms; restoration requires finite counterterms (worked out much later, S3.03 onward).
